summary: Jazz: swung 8ths on the ride, ii–V–I changes with 7th chords, walking bass, Rhodes, piano or vibes
body: Drums: swing ride (ding, ding-a-ding), hi-hat on 2 and 4, brushes or light snare comping.
Harmony: 7th chords everywhere; ii–V–I, turnarounds (I–vi–ii–V), tritone substitutions.
Bass: walking quarter notes through the changes.
Space: a small room, played softly; 'jazzier chords' usually means extending triads to 7ths and 9ths and adding ii–V movement.

Apply: pattern/gmd-jazz-swing-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/jazz-ii-v-i on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 90–200 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
